所选主题尚未在所有启用节点完成部署。: The selected theme is not deployed on every enabled node.
博客阅读界面，包含文章、说说与插件页面。: A blog reading theme for articles, short posts and plugin pages.
继承 Argon 的简约子主题，适合二次开发。: A minimal child theme of Argon, ready to customize.
恢复跟随部署中设定的默认主题。: Follow the default theme configured for this deployment.

机器调用使用 Key 的权限、有效期和请求频率控制。Key 无效或已撤销时直接拒: Machine requests use key permissions, expiry and rate limits. Invalid or revoked keys are rejected without falling back to anonymous access.

仅对授予“阅读免验证码”或“评论免验证码”的 Key 生效。已有 Key 不自动: Requires the Read without CAPTCHA or Comment without CAPTCHA permission. Existing keys gain no new permissions. Login and content passwords are checked independently.

阅读解锁、评论提交和验证码请求共用此额度；达到上限返回 429，不影响其他 Ke: Content unlocks, comment submissions and CAPTCHA requests share this budget. Exceeding it returns 429 without affecting other keys.

请检查验证码配置和请求频率。当前输入已保留。: Check the CAPTCHA settings and request limit. Your input has been kept.
